name: Study § Steady 2
source:
Meeting her—

That’s her first “study” in the subject of love.
As your meeting blossoms into friendship, and friendship deepens into affection, she’ll reveal many sides of herself to you.

Sometimes, on a whim, she’ll start calling you by [i]a special nickname*[/i]—
And just like that, the dynamic between you two begins to shift.

[b]Numazu Urumi[/b]: [i]“I’ve got over 150 nicknames to choose from. Take your pick!”[/i]
[b]Mamanoue Yuno[/b]: [i]“If choosing is too hard, I’ve got a default name ready for you.”[/i]
[i]*Note: The game comes with "default names" for a smoother, more natural experience.[/i]

Under the summer sky, by the lapping waves, watching fireworks together—
You’ll feel the distance between you grow smaller and smaller.

Sometimes, she’ll surprise you with a new outfit, something completely unexpected—
And you’ll find yourself captivated by this side of her, so different from her usual self.

[b]Yaesawa Yae[/b]: [i]“This swimsuit's a bit embarrassing, but if it makes you happy...”[/i]
[b]Mishima Kirara[/b]: [i]“What do you think? Feeling the heat from my sexy side?”[/i]

Day by day, moment by moment, you're becoming something more than just friends―― 
This is "Study § Steady".

Your summer school of love is now in session.
Get ready for Study § Steady 2, where your own unique love story is waiting to unfold――

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://www.web-marmalade.com/products/sts2/index.html#about-page]official website[/url]]
